assumptions.availability: Topic availability = semester_eligible AND sampled within-semester availability. Unavailable topics: available=0 and mastery forced to 0 in the observation (missing ≠ genuine zero; genuine zero keeps available=1).
assumptions.live_users: This simulator invents synthetic states only. Live PathPage must not invent mastery or diagnostic completion; Node heuristic remains the student flow.
assumptions.not_assistments: Does not reuse ASSISTments weights, coefficients, or skill IDs.
assumptions.not_v0_remap: Does not map retired se-path-sim-v0 topic IDs onto current C1 IDs.
assumptions.response_model: Synthetic linear probability of a correct practice *attempt*: P(correct)=clip(p_floor + p_slope*mastery, p_floor, p_ceil). Not fitted on fixtures or real SE logs.
assumptions.semester_mask: S1: actions outside the learner semester are always masked off. Synthetic learners are assigned an explicit semester at reset.
assumptions.step_definition: One environment step = one synthetic practice attempt on the selected topic.

reward_equation: r = correctness_reward_weight * 1[correct] + mastery_gain_weight * selected_topic_gain - time_cost_weight   (invalid / no-eligible: r = invalid_action_penalty; no mastery change)
